verdict.rationale: Google's Gmail page says suggested replies let you "reply in one click, in your voice". The Gemini help docs say it can create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity, which covers AI-drafted replies ready to review and send. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Gmail learns the user's personal voice and tone (beyond a marketing line), independent or hands-on evidence that drafts avoid generic boilerplate.
